item.title: TTT 250: Rachelle Is Right
item.description:
In this episode Eric is wrong and Rachelle is right. Also, we discuss horse semen, mannequin lovers (not the cute 80’s comedy kind), and what we’ve been up to over the last week.

Do you have any favourite moments between episodes 101 - 200? Let us know so we can put together another “best of” episode. Send the moment you liked, episode and time it was in to info@tiptaptip.com Episode Links
